# Kautusang Bayan No. 005, Series of 2008

**Ordinance Regulating Vehicle Weight on Barangay Roads**

## Summary

This ordinance prohibits vehicles weighing more than three (3) tons and having more than four (4) wheels from passing through barangay roads within the municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. The aim is to protect the roads from damage caused by heavy vehicles. Violators will be penalized with fines or imprisonment.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1:** Prohibits vehicles with more than four (4) wheels and weighing over three (3) tons from passing through barangay roads (Farm to Market Road) within the municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  **Section 2:** Reiterates the prohibition on vehicles with more than four (4) wheels and weighing over three (3) tons, especially those carrying heavy loads like lumber (Softwood), from passing through barangay roads in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
3.  **Section 3:** Exempts government vehicles used for public service and vehicles used for clearing barangay roads from the ordinance.
4.  **Section 4:** Exempts vehicles used for transporting poultry and hog farm products within the feeder road authorized by the ordinance.
5.  **Section 5:** Requests the assistance of barangay officials in implementing the ordinance.
6.  **Section 6:** Sets the penalty for violators at a fine of One Thousand Pesos (₱1,000.00) to Two Thousand Pesos (₱2,000.00) or imprisonment of seven (7) to fifteen (15) days, or both, at the discretion of the court.
7.  **Section 7:** States that fines collected will go to the treasury of the [[Bayan ng Pitogo]] and will be used for the benefit of the barangays where the violation occurred.
8.  **Section 8:** Declares that any provision inconsistent with the ordinance is repealed.
9.  **Section 9:** Orders the publication of the ordinance on the Bulletin Board of the Municipal Hall and other public places within the [[Bayan ng Pitogo, Quezon]].
